body.statement: Under the population dictionary, training measurability, conditional square-integrability, and bridge-rate conditions, the explicitly constructed fold dictionaries satisfy \[\max_k\|\widehat D_{J_n}^{(-k)}-D^0_{J_n}\|_{L^2(P)}=O_p(\delta_{D,n}),\qquad \delta_{D,n}=O_p\{B_{J_n}(e_{h,4,n}+e_{q,4,n})+e_{h,4,n}e_{q,4,n}\}.\] Conditional on \(\mathcal D_{-k}\), training/holdout independence and the fourth-moment growth condition give \(\eta_{G,n}=O_p\{J_nB_{J_n}^2\sqrt{\log(1+J_n)/n}+\sqrt{J_n}B_{J_n}\delta_{D,n}+J_n\delta_{D,n}^2\}\) and \(\eta_{c,n}=O_p\{\sqrt{J_n}B_{J_n}^2\sqrt{\log(1+J_n)/n}+\sqrt{J_n}B_{J_n}\delta_{D,n}\}\). The positive ridge makes every fold coefficient unique, and resolvent perturbation gives \[\max_k\|\widehat b^{(-k)\top}\widehat D_{J_n}^{(-k)}-\Pi_{\mathcal C_P}\phi_0\|_2=O_p\!\left(\alpha_{J_n}+L_n\delta_{D,n}+\frac{\eta_{G,n}+\eta_{c,n}}{\kappa_{J_n}}+b_{\rho,n}\right)=o_p(1).\] The explicit deterministic coefficient-to-weight identity then yields \(\|\widehat\psi-\theta(P)-\phi_{\mathrm{eff}}\|_2=o_p(1)\); this convergence is derived rather than assumed.
body.justification: The desired primitive-to-high-level projection step remains load-bearing.
body.gap: Dimension, multiplier, training-dependence, and Gram-null-space controls are missing from the current assumptions.
body.consumer: Those controls must be supplied before the affine ensemble is an implementable efficiency theorem.

obligation.what_is_open: Derive the claimed learned-dictionary and regularized projection rates from the listed primitive conditions for the displayed training-sample ridge construction.
obligation.obstruction: Uniform per-cell fourth-norm bridge rates do not by themselves give the stated vector dictionary rate without dimension and multiplier envelopes. The training Gram uses the same observations that fitted the dictionary, so holdout independence does not derive its concentration. With a singular population Gram, unprojected ridge inversion can amplify null-eigenspace cross-moment noise at the inverse ridge rate rather than the inverse positive-eigenvalue rate.
obligation.attempted: The signal difference was expanded into outcome, treatment, and product errors, and the resolvent equation was decomposed into range and null components. This verifies the deterministic affine identity and ridge uniqueness but isolates the missing multiplier, dependence, and null-space stability controls.
obligation.partial_result: The deterministic four-corner coefficient-to-weight identity and uniqueness of \((\widehat G+\rho_n I)^{-1}\widehat c\) are valid.  Conditional on the high-level conclusion \(\|\widehat\psi-\theta-\phi_{\mathrm{eff}}\|_2=o_p(1)\), the subsequent cross-fit empirical-process term is \(o_p(n^{-1/2})\).  The stated primitive assumptions do not yet prove that high-level conclusion for the displayed learned ridge projection.
